summary: Linux 1.0.68 read of 40 channels: frequencies correct, names start in one channel and continue in the next, some blank. Base TYT_TH-350 reads 5-byte names at 0x0A30; TYT_TH-350_US reads 8-byte names at 0x0930. Layouts are otherwise identical and match_model cannot tell them apart, so a US radio read as base gives exactly this. Reporter is in the US and used RT Systems. Ask them to read with TH-350 US and send the .img.
title: Channel names shifted across channels: likely TH-350 US radio read as base TH-350
